source: Current read-only GitLab project 61 master branch and all pages of its contributors API
scope_limit_zh: Moli 按逐条提交作者邮箱分组计 381，GitLab 贡献者 API 计 380；两种统计口径的具体差异未被本审计归因。两种独立读取均给出相同且唯一的最高提交者，当前 master 头提交一致。
scope_limit_en: Moli grouped individual commits by author email and counted 381 for the winner; GitLab's contributors API reports 380. This audit does not attribute the one-commit difference. Both reads identify the same unique leader at the same master head.
conclusion_zh: 固定版 Moli 的当前浏览器取数答案与独立读取的完整贡献者 API 一致；唯一最高提交者邮箱为 SecUpwN@users.noreply.github.com。
conclusion_en: The fixed-Moli browser-derived answer matches an independent complete contributors-API read: the unique top contributor email is SecUpwN@users.noreply.github.com.
